events.event_hazard: Cyclone Aila; storm surge; coastal flooding
key_impacts: Approximately 243,191 houses washed away and 370,587 partially damaged countrywide.
Dakshin Bedkashi: 3,520 houses washed away; 1,800 partially damaged; almost entire union inundated.
Storm surge breached the coastal embankment in six places; 20.55 km damaged.
Villages faced twice-daily tidal inundation until 2013, delaying recovery.
evidence_snippets: Cyclone Aila hit the Bangladesh coast on 25 May 2009 with a 2–6 m storm surge.
Koyra upazila was one of the worst affected areas by cyclone Aila.
In Dakshin Bedkashi, Aila killed 33 people and washed away 3,520 houses; 1,800 partially damaged.
